summary: Completed Module 01 Step 1 CONTEXT micro-exercise: Defined three essential preparation steps before prompting AI for Team Invitations feature.
evidence: Step 1 (Schema & Data Model): Audit existing user, team, and membership models to understand primary keys, foreign key constraints, role enums, and tenant isolation patterns.
Step 2 (Routing & Auth Conventions): Inspect existing route handlers and middleware to identify established patterns for dependency injection, authentication verification, and error handling.

Step 3 (Token & Delivery Infrastructure): Investigate existing token generation, cryptographic signing/hashing, expiration handling, and notification delivery patterns to reuse existing infrastructure rather than inventing new patterns.
